text_en: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
text_cn: 随后，我看见了一个新天新地，因为先前的天与先前的地已不见了，海也没有了。

text_en: And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
text_cn: 我看见那新耶路撒冷圣城，从天上由天主那里降下，就如一位装饰好迎接自己丈夫的新娘。

text_en: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, “See, the home of God is among mortals. He will dwell with them; they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them;
text_cn: 我听见由宝座那里有一巨大声音说：“这就是天主与人同在的帐幕，他要同他们住在一起；他们要作他的人民，他亲自要‘与他们同在’，作他们的天主；

text_en: he will wipe every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; mourning and crying and pain will be no more, for the first things have passed away. ”
text_cn: 他要拭去他们眼上的一切泪痕；以后再也没有死亡，再也没有悲伤，没有哀号，没有苦楚，因为先前的都已过去了。”

text_en: And the one who was seated on the throne said, “See, I am making all things new. ” Also he said, “Write this, for these words are trustworthy and true. ”
text_cn: 那位坐在宝座上的说：“看，我已更新了一切。”又说：“你写下来！因为这些话都是可信而真实的。”

text_en: Then he said to me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will give water as a gift from the spring of the water of life.
text_cn: 他又给我说：“已完成了！我是‘阿耳法’和‘敖默加’，元始和终末。我要把生命的水白白地赐给口渴的人喝。

text_en: Those who conquer will inherit these things, and I will be their God and they will be my children.
text_cn: 胜利者必要承受这些福分；我要作他的天主，他要作我的儿子。

text_en: But as for the cowardly, the faithless, the polluted, the murderers, the fornicators, the sorcerers, the idolaters, and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death. ”
text_cn: 可是，为那些怯懦的、失信的、可耻的、杀人的、奸淫的、行邪术的、拜偶像的，以及一切撒谎的人，他们的地方是在烈火与硫磺燃烧着的坑中：这就是第二次死亡。”

text_en: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb. ”
text_cn: 那拿着七个满盛最后七种灾祸盂的七位天使，其中有一位来告诉我说：“你来！我要把羔羊的净配新娘指给你看。”

text_en: And in the spirit he carried me away to a great, high mountain and showed me the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God.
text_cn: 天使就使我神魂超拔，把我带到一座又大又高的山上，将那从天上，由天主那里降下的圣城耶路撒冷，指给我看。

text_en: It has the glory of God and a radiance like a very rare jewel, like jasper, clear as crystal.
text_cn: 这圣城具有天主的光荣；城的光辉，好似极贵重的宝石，像水晶那么明亮的苍玉；

text_en: It has a great, high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and on the gates are inscribed the names of the twelve tribes of the Israelites;
text_cn: 城墙高而且大，有十二座门，守门的有十二位天使，门上写着以色列子民十二支派的名字。

text_en: on the east three gates, on the north three gates, on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
text_cn: 东面三门，北面三门，南面三门，西面三门。

text_en: And the wall of the city has twelve foundations, and on them are the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
text_cn: 城墙有十二座基石，上面刻着羔羊的十二位宗徒的十二个名字。

text_en: The angel who talked to me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city and its gates and walls.
text_cn: 同我谈话的那位天使拿着金芦苇测量尺，要测量那城、城门和城墙。

text_en: The city lies foursquare, its length the same as its width; and he measured the city with his rod, fifteen hundred miles; its length and width and height are equal.
text_cn: 城是四方形的，长宽相同。天使用芦苇测量尺测量了那城，共计一万二千‘斯塔狄’，长、宽、高都相等；

text_en: He also measured its wall, one hundred forty-four cubits by human measurement, which the angel was using.
text_cn: 又测量了城墙，有一百四十四肘；天使用的，是人的尺寸。

text_en: The wall is built of jasper, while the city is pure gold, clear as glass.
text_cn: 城墙是用水苍玉建造的，城是纯金的，好像明净的玻璃。

text_en: The foundations of the wall of the city are adorned with every jewel; the first was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
text_cn: 城墙的基石，是用各种宝石装饰的：第一座基石是水苍玉，第二座是蓝玉，第三座是玉髓，第四座是翡翠，

text_en: the fifth onyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
text_cn: 第五座是赤玛瑙，第六座是斑玛瑙，第七座是橄榄石，第八座是绿柱石，第九座是黄玉，第十座是绿玉，第十一座是紫玉，第十二座是紫晶。

text_en: And the twelve gates are twelve pearls, each of the gates is a single pearl, and the street of the city is pure gold, transparent as glass.
text_cn: 十二座门是十二种珍珠，每一座门是由一种珍珠造的；城中的街道是纯金的，好似透明的玻璃。

text_en: I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb.
text_cn: 在城内我没有看见圣殿，因为上主全能的天主和羔羊就是她的圣殿。

text_en: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God is its light, and its lamp is the Lamb.
text_cn: 那城也不需要太阳和月亮光照，因为有天主的光荣照耀她；羔羊就是她的明灯。

text_en: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
text_cn: 万民都要藉着她的光行走，世上的君王也要把自己的光荣带到她内。

text_en: Its gates will never be shut by day—and there will be no night there.
text_cn: 她的门白日总不关闭，因为那里已没有黑夜。

text_en: People will bring into it the glory and the honor of the nations.
text_cn: 万民都要把自己的光荣和财富运到她内。

text_en: But nothing unclean will enter it, nor anyone who practices abomination or falsehood, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
text_cn: 凡不洁净、行可耻的事及撒谎的，绝对不得进入她内；只有那些记载在羔羊生命册上的，才得进入。
